banglaExplanation: CBT-তে আসল প্রশ্ন: training শেষে workplace-এ লোকটা কী করতে পারে।
Program modules দিয়ে তৈরি, আর modules ভাগ হয় learning outcomes-এ।
Modules industry standards-এর ওপর ভিত্তি করে বানানো।
Progress সময়ের ওপর নির্ভর করে না; module শেষ হলেই পরের module-এ যাওয়া যায়।

example.bn: প্লাম্বিং কোর্সে যে আগে module শেষ করে, সে আগেই পরের module-এ যায়।
example.en: A fast learner in a plumbing course finishes module 1 early. He moves straight to module 2.

realQuestions.answer:
Competency based training (CBT) places emphasis on what a person can do in the
workplace as a result of completing a program of training.
CBT programs are often comprised of modules broken into segments called learning
outcomes. These modules are based on standards set by industry, and assessment
is designed to ensure each student has achieved all module outcomes.
Progress within a CBT program is not based on time. When students complete the
requirements in a module, they can move to the next module, therefore they may be
able to complete a program of study quickly.
Some CBT programs will only be available within fixed timeframes and some have on
the job and outside the job components.
